design.backend: QAOA p=1, Aer MPS simulation on classical hardware
design.corpus: nghttp3 QPACK bookkeeping, controlled faults and pristine controls

limitations: DEV mechanisms were previously exposed; this is exploratory.
QAOA uses classical MPS simulation and cannot establish physical quantum speedup.
With eight positive instances per row, one finding changes a complete rate by 12.5 percentage points.
Two comparator rows are incomplete; R_C, D_DEV and I_DEV remain null.
One Predator pristine-control episode has unsupported evidence; no perfect-specificity claim.
QAOA selection retained the AI starting assignment in 30 of 31 recorded Predator stages; optimizer attribution remains unresolved.
Objective energies from different compiled problems are not a common scale.
Finding counts are controlled fault instances, not new vulnerabilities or CVEs.
The descriptive differences do not establish statistical significance, a scaling law or independent replication.
Four native checks on controlled-fault traces are INCONSISTENT; these are preserved and are not verified findings. The banked episode score is unchanged.

operations.ci_incident: One CI job was interrupted during the first reservation race; the incident is retained.
operations.recovery: Four never-started episodes completed with a hash-bound streaming wrapper; missing episodes were not retried.

release_scope.not_reproduced_here: A fresh model/optimizer/native campaign or independent verification of private receipts.
release_scope.public: Aggregate outcomes, sanitized stage/check provenance, figures and local reconstruction code.
release_scope.reproducible_here: Arithmetic, paired outcome heatmap, stage/check graph and public export validation.
release_scope.withheld: Raw source/patches, prompts, trace payloads, provider IDs, private receipt bodies, account details, host addresses, infrastructure paths and execution controls.

source.atlas_disposition: evidence-only; no fact, routing or claim promotion
source.pr_scope: Post-campaign reliability and discovery preregistration; Experiment #1 evidence is inherited unchanged.
